lines.text: You'd never guess why this lane flooded for five days without rain.
Nobody did. Except a paper boat.
Here's the forecast for Lane four.
Monday. Ankle deep. Only Arjun's tall SUV gets out.
He ferries Rohan. Hero.
Tuesday. Knee deep. Rohan, Priya, Sharma ji.
Wednesday. Waist deep. Nine people and the guard's cycle on the roof.
Then, petrol money.
Rohan pays UPI. Priya pays cash. Sharma ji pays in blessings.
Friday. Arjun's heart is full. His tank is empty.
Knee deep, they argue: how many blessings per litre?
Ferry service, cancelled.
Then a kid floats a paper boat.
Every boat drifts away from the same gate. Arjun's.
His roof tank. Overflowing. Pump on all week.
He switches it on, then leaves to be the hero.
Lesson: when one hero does all the driving, nobody checks the hero.
So Lane four moved to an app.
Petrol goes in settle costs, split evenly.
The roster gives every car its own morning.
The pump? The guard switches it off now. Personally.
Tomorrow's forecast: dry, with scattered blessings.
One hero doing every drive? Sahyatri. Link in bio.
